name: Lived Through Hell

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
You saw countless people die in the brutal war that preceded Queen Abrogail becoming an archdevil as she completed the ritual that transformed Cheliax into the 10th layer of Hell. Whether you allied with devils, fought against them, or hid from the war entirely, you went through Hell and lived to tell the tale, and you've kept some of the secret knowledge that allowed you to survive.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Occultism skill and the Devil Lore skill. You gain the Schooled in Secrets skill feat.
